combo_label: At the Cinema × Stained Glass × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Hargreaves' blobby little fellows, taken all together as a brand
Not a spare place left in the room, a board up at the door
Diminutive Mr Men chap; also the size of drink below a medium
Brimming with questions, or else oddly hard to explain
Tortilla chips smothered in lurid cheese sauce at the counter
Alkali in the mix that lets sand melt at a workable temperature
Sentimental film chosen on purpose for a good cry in the dark
Blue powder crushed from a tinted melt and long used as a colouring
A tangle or mix-up; also the Hargreaves chap who wears his shoes on his hands
Letting not a single ray of daylight through
Built street of false fronts where the filming was done
Tool with a tiny hardened wheel for scoring a line on glass
